product_summary: Catalogue (IndiaMART-hosted site pbholotech.com, Kolkata, CB-70 Salt Lake City; director Brijesh Ranilawala; GST 19AACCP2435P1Z0, CIN U24100WB2000PTC091995 as stated on the page) shows the real product range is security holograms and printed labels, not plastic film in rolls: (1) Holographic products — 3D hologram stickers, hologram scratch cards, combination-effects hologram, instant hologram labels, flip-image hologram, holo-kinetic hologram, hologram paper labels, 3D lenticular labels; material stated as metallized polyester (PET) / PET, thickness 36 microns, supplied in sheet and roll form. (2) Heat transfer film line — heat transfer film, plastic hot stamping foil, PP container heat transfer film, pen heat transfer films, black foil for number plates. (3) Labels/tags — liquor bottle labels, BOPP self-adhesive labels, printed shrink labels, PVC shrink label, water bottle labels, direct thermal labels, label stock roll, chromo gum sheet, maplitho paper sheet, garment tags with hologram strip, clothing size stickers, tea bag tags (Constanta/MAISA/IMA), induction sealing wads, dry heat indicator labels, in-mould labels, ice-cream cone sleeves, MBOPP/HST tea envelopes, rice-bag sealing tape, holographic self-adhesive roll, non-adhesive holographic tape, barcode labels, serial number labels. (4) Non-core resale items — Blitz 2253 numbering machine, envelope making machine.
role_hint: manufacturer (self-declared 'Nature of Business: Manufacturer', 101-500 employees, GST reg. 01-07-2017); no trader signs found in the catalogue, but the numbering machine / envelope making machine lines are clearly bought-in resale items
comment: Declared 3920.20 (plates/sheets/film of polymers of propylene) is only PARTIALLY corroborated. The site does describe holographic/metallized packaging film and holographic aluminium foil, but the stated substrate is metallized POLYESTER (PET), not polypropylene — that would fall under 3920.62 (PET film) or 3921.90 (other laminated/metallized plates, sheets, film), not 3920.20. Moreover the dominant actual output is cut-to-shape self-adhesive hologram stickers and printed labels, which are NOT chapter 39 goods at all: self-adhesive printed labels → 3919.10/3919.90 (or 4821.10/4821.90 if paper-based), printed paper labels/tags → 4821.10/4821.90, tea bag tags and chromo/maplitho sheets → 4821/4823.20, shrink sleeves → 3923.50, induction sealing wads → 3926.90 or 3919, hot stamping foil → 3212.10, envelope making machine → 8441.10. So the declaration captures at most one sub-line of a much broader, label/hologram-centric range. Industry claimed as 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a clear MISCLASSIFICATION — this is a security-printing / packaging-converter / label manufacturer (holograms, labels, tags, tapes, sleeves), with no oil & gas or bulk chemical activity visible anywhere in the catalogue. Per project rule 3 the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: company is retained, code should be corrected to the actual label/hologram/film mix (lead codes 3919.10, 4821.10, 3920.62, 3921.90) and the industry field corrected to packaging/security printing. All product lines above are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — they come from the company's own IndiaMART catalogue and website only; no customs line, B/L or GST turnover record was checked in this task (out of scope), so no shipment-level corroboration exists for any code. Note also that the site is an IndiaMART-hosted microsite, so catalogue content is self-declared marketing, not independently verified.
